asr.full_text: The BJP meeting was attended by 25 centres including Amisha J.P. Nadha. The BJP meeting also discussed the party strategy in Parliament. The strategy was to respond with logic to the health of the opposition. Today the Congress Parliament Strategy Group is also going to be batted. The Congress leader can be changed to Lok Sabha. Today the Subba 11 will be the cabinet of the Union. On July 16th, PM Modi Gandhi will also inaugurate the 5 star hotel built at the Nagar Railway Station. He will also blow up the robotic and aquatic gallery. The election runner Prachan Kishore met Rahul Gandhi at Rahul's home in Delhi. After meeting Rahul Gandhi, Harish Ra said that the next 3-4 days will bring good news to the Punjab Congress. BJP senator Sadhy Pragya has said that the Rohingya and Bangladeshis are taking advantage of the government facilities of demanding a population control law. Congress chief batch in Maharashtra, Nana Patole said. Maratha and OBC reservations were discussed. Sharad Pawar met HK Patil Ashok Chawan and Bala Saib Thuda. The Congress demands a sharp reduction in the prices of petrol diesel and LPG. Finance Minister Pich Dambaram also demanded to compile import duties and reduce the GST rate on goods. The target of the Centre of Raul Gandhi said that rain or sunshine does not relieve the economy. The planetary minister Satyajit Ray asked why Raul is attacked by Pakistan and China. The Special Cell of Delhi Police team will be fighting the terrorists of Al Qaeda who have been captured. Seem Ugy's statement in Gurkpur has failed to achieve a major defeat of the terrorists in the state. Public safety is our priority. In Fulwama, Jammu and Kashmir, the joint operation of the Encounter Police and Security Affairs is reported to have been carried out by some terrorists. The Prime Minister will also speak to the Seams of several states on July 16. Modi will get information on the situation of Corona. In the country, 40,443 new cases of Corona have come to light. 623 people have died in 24 hours. The country has seen a 6% reduction in the number of Kuruk Kreses compared to the previous week. More than 100 members of the Commission have already confirmed the statement on the policy of the country. In 24 hours, 124 people have died. The first Corona infection in India has been confirmed with Corona. A year later, a doctor in Tiruvarnathpuram has confirmed Zika virus. A total of 22 cases of Zika virus have been reported in Kerala. 7243 new cases of Kuruna have been reported in Maharashtra. 196 people have died in 24 hours. 66 prisoners of Kuruna virus have been confirmed positive in Raigar Jail in Maharashtra and transferred to Covid Centre. Over 34 people have been vaccinated in the last 24 hours. Haryana has so far been vaccinated with over a crore vaccines. State Health Minister Anil Vij informed. Athletics are being built in Mumbai before going to the Olympics. Along with vaccination centres, study and work, people travelling abroad will also be able to get vaccines. WHO statement on booster doses The vaccinated people do not need to take booster doses yet. The government of Uttarakhand has also banned travel to Kawada this year in view of the coronavirus. The government of Odisha has banned the use of round bomb sheds in the month of Savan. Schools will open in Chandigarh from July 19 to 12 after the permission of school parents from 9 to 12. The people of Bwal walked on each other for vaccination in Gopal Ganch, Mihar. Police held the police by charging the police. Delhi Sultan Puri Sabji Mandi has been ordered to close till July 16. Action has been taken for breaking the rules of Kuruna. Gujarat Dwarka temple collapsed. A woman is still being arrested. A woman is still being held in a nine-person shooting. A yellow alert is issued in Kullu, Himachal Pradesh. All adventure sports will be closed until September 15. A 16-year-old girl was arrested in Dili's Moti Bagh. The accused had killed the girl with a broomstick. The management of Mumbai International Air Code has now promised to give thousands of jobs to Adani Group. The Bhim UPI app launched in Bhutan will benefit Indian travellers and businessmen. The Prime Minister has expressed his concern for the players participating in the Olympics. The country is with you. The Prime Minister also spoke to well-known players like Mericom, Sanya Mirza and Neeraj Chopra. We are confident in the success of the players. Hi, I am Minakshi Joshi Subscribe to India TV YouTube channel to stay updated with videos and news.
